Hospital Packages at
Matilda International Hospital

Matilda International Hospital offers thoughtfully designed packages at predetermined prices to cover the most frequently performed procedures. We provide two types of packages to meet your healthcare needs: Total Care Packages and Hospital Packages.

Total Care Packages

What’s Included

  • Doctor fees
  • Nursing care
  • Room (meals included for overnight packages)
  • Treatments associated with the procedure as specified in the package
Available only with designated doctors.

Hospital Packages

What’s Included

  • Nursing care
  • Room (meals included for overnight packages)
  • Treatments associated with the procedure as specified in the package
Doctor fees are excluded.
